notes.title: Expanding Our Linguistic Horizons 🌍🗣️
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm super excited to share some amazing news with you today! 🎉

After countless cups of coffee and long nights of coding, I've just rolled out support for 9 new languages in the game! Now you can play in:


 Russian
 Spanish
 Portuguese
 Italian
 French
 Turkish
 Indonesian
 Filipino
 Polish


It's been quite the journey getting here - you should have seen me juggling all these different alphabets and trying to make sure every single line of dialogue hits just right in each language. There were definitely moments where my brain felt like it was doing linguistic gymnastics! 😅

But you know what? Seeing the game come alive in all these different languages has been absolutely worth every minute. I really want this game to be something everyone can enjoy, no matter what language they speak.

🚀 What's Coming Next?

But wait, there's more! I'm already working on adding:


 Japanese
 Chinese
 Korean
 Arabic


These are taking a bit longer because they use completely different writing systems, but I'm determined to get them right!

⚠️ Quick Note
Just a heads up - the Polish version might be a bit wonky at times. I'm actively working on fixing those bugs, so if you spot anything weird while playing in Polish, please let me know!

🎮 Try It Out!

Want to see how the game feels in your language? The demo has been updated with all these new translations! 

👉 Play the Demo Demo 

If you're enjoying what you're seeing, it would mean the world to me if you could:

💗 Wishlist the game on Steam
🔊 Share this update with your friends
🎯 Try out the demo and let me know what you think!

Your support keeps me going through all these late-night coding sessions! 

Happy gaming! 🎮✨

P.S. Are you multilingual? I'd love your feedback on the translations! Drop a comment below if you spot anything that could be improved.

notes.title: Full Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Updates:

 5+ languages now available
 Enhanced sound effects and ambiance with balanced audio
 Expanded demo content to reveal more of the game’s mysterious story


What Makes Outrun Unique:

 Dual perspectives revealing a complex, twisty story
 A blend of suspense, psychological horror, and chilling sound design and graphic design
 Realistic, physics-based object interaction – a unique horror experience with a cleaning simulator twist


Upcoming for Full Release:

 5+ additional languages
 New cleaning techniques inspired by quirky real-life motel stories
 And more surprises!


Thank you all for the amazing support as I approach the final release!
